name: pdk-fitnet-contract-pass-offer-pipeline
instr:
The Chapter 4 Fitnet system must deliver one pass for every signed contract and one extension offer for every expired pass. A sign that returns 201 must lead to exactly one `ContractSignedEvent` and one pass even if RabbitMQ is stopped for 20 seconds while it is accepted: within 30 seconds after the broker is back the pass must appear, with no restart or manual step; the same holds if the Contracts process that accepted the sign is killed before the broker returns, counting from when the broker and a Contracts process are running again. Five concurrent signs of the same prepared contract across two Contracts processes must give exactly one 201 and four 409 responses and one pass. A normal sign produces its customer's pass in `GET /api/passes` within 15 seconds.

Passes must apply repeated `ContractSignedEvent` deliveries with different transport message IDs, across two Fitnet processes and beyond a 30-second transport inbox window, only once per contract. A 20-second Passes database outage must not lose incoming events; each pass must appear within 30 seconds of recovery, with retries following transient failures. Expiring a pass must return 204 and yield an extension offer within 15 seconds; four concurrent expiry requests across two Fitnet processes must each return 204, and repeated expiration messages (including ones with different event IDs) must produce exactly one offer per pass.
